## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what this change fixes and what users or operators will observe.

## Validation

List meaningful checks and their results. For handoff or isolation changes,
include the relevant failure or takeover scenario.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented where needed.
- [ ] Tests cover material new behavior or failures.
- [ ] Examples use fictional data.
- [ ] No credentials, customer records, runtime files or prospect data are included.
